StoreChunk.title: Store Chunk
StoreChunk.description: A chunk of the global application state.

TeamLogo.title: Team Logo
TeamLogo.description: Custom logo or badge for a team or organization.

UserPreference.title: User Preference
UserPreference.description: User UI preferences such as theme, contrast, and font size.

ConsultantPhoto.title: Consultant Photo
ConsultantPhoto.description: Custom photo for a consultant or psychologist.

AssetItem.title: Asset Item
AssetItem.description: Dedicated media asset including official logos, circular badges, and consultant photos stored as explicit documents.

assets/{assetId}.description: Stores individual logos, badges, and consultant photos in a dedicated structured assets collection.

store/{chunkId}.description: Stores chunks of the global application state (JSON strings) to bypass 1MB limit slightly and organize.

team_logos/{teamId}.description: Stores individual team and organization logos in Firestore for persistent multi-session access.

consultant_photos/{consultantId}.description: Stores consultant profile photos in Firestore for persistent multi-session access.

preferences/{prefId}.description: Stores user settings and preferences in Firestore.
